project.name: EWS Event Contracts Test
project.description: JVM-native schema validation, complementing the Python-based validate-schemas CI job (.github/workflows/ci.yml). Parses every Avro contract under schemas/events/** via the Avro Java library (exercising the same avro-maven-plugin parser used by ews-schemas) and every JSON Schema contract under schemas/** via the networknt json-schema-validator library. Satisfies the coherence-review backlog item "Add CI that parses every JSON/Avro schema" (docs/architecture/05-coherence-review-parts-i-iii.md Section 5, item 1).
